test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six friends; A, L, V, P, Q and M each have different heights. P is taller than only four other friends. V is taller than only one friend. Q is taller than M but shorter than A. A is not the tallest. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
solution:
Given: Six friends A, L, V, P, Q and M each have different heights.

P is taller than only four other friends

_ > P > _ > _ > _ > _

V is taller than only one friend

_ > __P__ > _ > _ > __V__ > _

Q is taller than M but shorter than A, A is not the tallest.

A > Q > M 

On combining we get, 

__L __> __P__ > __A__ > __Q__ > __V__ > __M__

M is shortest among all friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
